title: fix(cli): name gen image output after the response content-type
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Fixed `polli gen image` saving JPEG responses as `image.png` when `--output` is omitted. The CLI now chooses `image.jpg`, `image.png`, `image.webp`, or `image.svg` from the response Content-Type, ignoring case and parameters; unknown types still default to `image.png`. An explicit `--output` remains unchanged, including creation of its parent folder before the request. Human and `--json` output report the path actually written, help text describes extension inference, and the CLI skill documents the expected default filename. Added tests for JPEG output, parameterized PNG Content-Type, and an explicit output path.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli wears a tiny photographer’s beret and labels a freshly printed picture `image.jpg` beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant, while a small CRT monitor robot checks the file label. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She should be small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements — never oversized or dominating the image. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; warm cream background with soft lime green (#ecf874) glow and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
